title: Ordered bench ladder: working duplex lap -> first calibration alg set_* messages

preconditions.firmware: PD4-patched FIRMWARE.bin (local: image sha256 cfe24bfb..., stub in safe cave CPU 0x108240, entered from boot-task epilogue, polls out[0]=CA 0x40039010 and calls fw H2D dispatcher wrapper 0x40294)
preconditions.driver: hi5622_wifi.ko 400,732 B sha256 774c4f1f... (lane wifi-h2d-send/src), params fw_path=<PD4 image>, h2d_send_budget=<see steps>, hcc_poll_ms, ecc
preconditions.device_state: cold chip, single clean GPIO reset pulse, rings armed, PD4 golden boot expected
preconditions.safety: host-only writes via the clean driver; no 0xCECE during boot; never write CA 0x400392F0; one frame per idea for every new message class

boot_sequence: echo prepare > endpoint attrs; upload; verify (diffs=0); seed (platform 24-word block + wifi 618-word block)
wait: handshake page CA 0x1BF000 == 0x86807FEF / 0x00000007 / 0x00000002 / 0x0000ABCD, state CA 0x118B60 == 1, mask CA 0x40008 == 0
hcc_ready: phase READY_TXQ_SYNC, ready pair id1+id2 decoded (payload 0x01060850), direct reader frames>0

steps.name: pack read before the lap
steps.action: read BAR0 window (read-only): ctx190 = BAR0 0x7D45E8, ctx0 = 0x7D4458, table entry = 0x829468, mask = CA 0x40008, exception staging = BAR0 0x6F800C
steps.expected: ctx190 = 0, ctx0 = 0, mask = 0, staging all zero
steps.stop: any nonzero mask/state deviation -> stop, do not send

steps.name: context-create (precondition of the TXQ sync)
steps.action: echo 1 > h2d_ctx_create  (g0 id1 key 0x0064, type 1; 48-byte wire frame)
steps.expected: rc=0, consumed in 0 polls (out[0] 0x8 -> 0); ctx190 != 0 (context allocated, e.g. 0x01011448); ctx0 = 4; mask stays 0

steps.name: TXQ config sync
steps.expected: rc=0, consumed in 0 polls; mask CA 0x40008 stays 0; exception staging BAR0 0x6F800C stays all zero; page/state golden
steps.stop: mask != 0 or staging frame appears -> stop

steps.name: read the D2H answers of the lap
steps.action: cat rd_catalog / dmesg tail (read-only direct group-A DR reader)
steps.expected: NEW g1 id3 frame total 36 (hmac_event_config_syn, syn_id 0x07E0 vap-MIB update, field B 4) and NEW g1 id0x12 frame total 40 (hmac_event_acs_response family, field B 0x12) - both decoded by tools/proto_seq_frames.py
steps.stop: mask != 0, page change, or frames absent -> record and stop; decode bytes with tools/proto_seq_frames.py --decode-id3/--decode-id12

steps.name: calibration probe fire #1 (recommended first calibration message)
steps.action: fire ONE g0 id2 key 0x0101 frame: set_rssi_param (cfg 3507), value area 40 zero bytes, field B = 4 (module our context-create made), dst 0, node length = declared total 298; generated by: python3 tools/proto_seq_frames.py --emit 3507
steps.prerequisites: the driver needs a send path for structured g0 id2 frames (the existing h2d_send grammar only carries id1 messages); integration: reuse h2d_build_g0_cfg_event(id=2,...) + the SR node/mailbox gates of h2d_send (READY/ACTIVE, lane open, budget)
expected: H2D announce consumed in 0 polls; mask CA 0x40008 == 0
NEW D2H g1 id3 total 298: payload syn_id 0x0101, body_len 270, body u16 @0 = 3507, body u32 @4 (dev_ret) = 0
steps.stop: mask != 0 / page change / not consumed -> stop, close the lane (read exception record + staging) and do not send another message on this boot; if consumed but NO response -> the g0 id2 handler rejected the field-B object: next boot retry ONE variant (field B = 0x00 or 0x12), one variable per boot

steps.name: calibration sequence fire (second boot, after C1 success)
steps.action: fresh PD4 golden boot; h2d_send_budget=5; fire in vendor order: set_2g_power_param (3502, 104 zero bytes), set_2g_low_power_param (3503, 104), set_5g_power_param (3504, 70), set_5g_low_power_param (3505, 70), set_xo_ppm_cali_param (3506, u32 0 -> firmware default path)
steps.expected: each announce consumed in 0 polls; five g1 id3 answers with syn_id 0x0101 and the matching cfg ids; mask 0; page/state golden; no new g1 id0x12
steps.stop: on the first failure stop and re-run the single-message variant for that command on a fresh boot (bisect by message, not by value)

steps.name: canonical full sequence (third boot)
steps.action: fresh PD4 golden boot; h2d_send_budget=6; fire all six in the vendor script order: 3502, 3503, 3504, 3505, 3506, 3507
steps.expected: six consumed announces, six g1 id3 syn 0x0101 answers (cfg ids in order), zero exceptions; boot page/state unchanged; h2d_status ok=6 timeout=0 refused=0
steps.stop: same stop rules; this is the vendor startup sequence that precedes netifd VAP create

steps.name: optional value-carrying run (attended, local cal file only)
steps.action: repeat C3 with per-unit calibration values injected from the local factory file (never committed) via tools/proto_seq_frames.py --emit <cfg> --values-hex <local>
steps.stop: if the firmware reports dev_ret != 0 for a value, the parser rejected the value size/layout - do not widen the test

observables_glossary.mask CA 0x40008: firmware exception vector mask; must stay 0 for every step
observables_glossary.handshake page CA 0x1BF000: 0x86807FEF / 7 / 2 / 0xABCD is the golden boot; any change means the firmware faulted
observables_glossary.ctx190 BAR0 0x7D45E8: context pointer written by the type-1 context-create; nonzero after P1
observables_glossary.exception staging BAR0 0x6F800C: all zero means no exception frame was staged
observables_glossary.out[0] CA 0x40039010: H2D pending bitmap; consumed == 0 after the firmware dispatcher ran
observables_glossary.rd_catalog: direct group-A DR reader catalogue; new g1 frames appear here

one_variable_rule: for every message class: first fire ONE frame on a fresh golden boot; only after the expected response is observed may a multi-message boot be attempted
